newsitem.title: UK: Two cargoes added to April Brent programme - trade.
newsitem.headline: Two cargoes added to April Brent programme - trade.

text.p: The April North Sea Brent Blend crude oil loading programme has been increased by two full cargoes, traders said on Friday.
One April 25-27 cargo was added to the programme on Thursday. The second cargo was due to be nominated loading dates of April 28-30 on Friday, they said.
The additions bring the total April Brent programme to 37 full cargoes plus an additional 1.4 million barrels in top-ups, still the equivalent of six cargoes fewer than in March, the traders said.
